title: App Access for Reviewers
intro: This page provides login details for Google Play and other store reviewers to access restricted areas of the BizApp365 Android app and related services.
The demo account below is configured for Enterprise edition access across accounting, inventory, CRM, service center, HR, barcode, and VAN field sales modules.
androidSteps: On server setup, enter Host: demo.bizapp365.com, Port: 443, and enable HTTPS/SSL.
Select company code DEMO (Demo Trading LLC).
Sign in with Username play.review@bizapp365.com and Password BizApp365Review2026!
If license activation appears, use the pre-configured Enterprise demo license for the DEMO company.
Two-factor authentication is disabled for this reviewer account.
webSteps: Open the BizApp365 web client configured for the DEMO company on the same server host.
Sign in with the same username and password listed above.
playConsoleInstructions: In Google Play Console, go to Policy and programs > App content > App access.
Select "All or some functionality is restricted".
Choose "Provide instructions for access" (and credentials where requested).
Additional instructions: Use server host demo.bizapp365.com (port 443, HTTPS), company code DEMO, then sign in with the credentials above. No 2FA. Enterprise modules are enabled on the demo company.
